book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Balɛt bɛ Hɛlod biih mwɛɛ Jiso le
No ŋgoo yi bamii ba sage bansa jɛmɛ noo, bo mo bo ja bo bachii bo jo Jiso bo gɛɛne bɛ wu fɛ Balɛt le.

No bo gɛnɛ bo bu fo, bo kɛ bo tu bo chuuyi mwɛɛ ye ye le, bo duu lɛ, “Muh wunɛ jiɛnyi wu chɛŋe bɛ woŋ wese, wu faŋe lɛ keefɛ bamii laaŋe ŋwa Kaisa wù Nfoŋ wu Lum le gɛ, wu ka jɛmɛ lɛ wu le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, fi duunyi lɛ wu le Nfoŋ wumu tɛ.”
Balɛt biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le wo wu le Nfoŋ Bajuu?” Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,
Balɛt mo wu ja wu jɛmɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ kinchvu ki bamii ki gɛ̀ bee fo le lɛ, “Mbaaŋ yɛŋ gɛ fiɛɛ fì muh wunɛ jiale le gɛ.”
Bo bachii tu bo nyiide gɛh lɛ, “Muh wunɛ jiɛnyi wu yɛyi bamii woŋ wu Judia le wuchii wu nyiise lɛ bo tɛɛme bikwɛɛ. Wu gɛ̀ kɛ Galalee, wu le wu to wa wu fɛsɛ mɛɛse a kinlaantɛŋ kinɛ le.”
No Balɛt yu finɛ noo, wu mo wu biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wunɛ le muh wu Galalee?”
Bo bɛɛŋ, wu mo wu tuŋ Jiso fɛ Nfoŋ Hɛlod le, nje le wu wù gɛ̀ sage kimbe ki woŋ kwɛɛ le, wu gɛ̀ bee tɛ Yɛlusalɛm kife kiyu le.
Bo gɛɛŋ bɛ Jiso, Nfoŋ Hɛlod yɛŋ wu le wu yu njoŋ baaŋ, nje wu gɛ̀ shee wu yuge kune wu, wù kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ ki wu yɛ̂ŋ wu le, wu jiiŋe tɛ lɛ segemu Jiso lé wu gê fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo wu yɛŋ.
Wu she wu biih mwɛɛ Jiso le wesee, geenɛ wu gɛ chvuu fiɛɛ gɛ.
Wu gɛ̀ biide bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo lɛme tɛ fo bo chuunyi mwɛɛ mù tɛɛme ye yi Jiso le.
Nfoŋ Hɛlod bɛ bamii be banchi ja bo mo bo kɛ bo keede wu, bo sɛɛse wu, bo susɛ wu bɛ njú yi woŋ, bo chwɛɛsɛ wu bo chvuu wu tu jiŋ fɛ Balɛt le.
Gɛ̀ bee Balɛt bɛ Nfoŋ Hɛlod banɛ. Abvubwɛɛ, bo tu nsaŋ.
Balɛt suunɛ nsa no bamii gɛh koŋe
No bo chvuse Jiso jiŋ, Balɛt kuŋ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ, wu ka wu kuŋ bamii bachii.

Bo taashɛ, wu du bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ be too bɛ muh wunɛ fɛnɛ lɛ wù gee bamii tɛɛme bikwɛɛ, ndoo ntaa mwɛɛ mu bɛŋ nyiide bɛ mu a bɛŋ jii, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, mbaaŋ yɛŋ gɛ mwɛɛ mù bɛŋ chuunyi ye ye le lɛ wu le wu ge fiɛɛ fimi gɛ,
Nfoŋ Hɛlod tɛ be baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ. Le fiɛɛ fì be ge fɛ wu kaasɛ wu chvuu muh wunɛ jiŋ besabɛŋ le. Bɛŋ yɛŋ tɛ lɛ muh wunɛ baaŋ jiaa gɛ fiɛɛ fì taŋlo ba yuuyɛ lo wu gɛ.
Noo, nlé ntâaŋ gɛh lo wu, nchînɛ wu le, wu gɛ̂ɛne.”
[To nyume kife ki Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wunɛ, tu Balɛt kɛme ki wu bvûsɛ muh wu mumwaa yeh yi cha le wu nya bamii le.]
Bamii bachii mo bo ja bo kɛ bo wanɛ lo bo gɛɛne yu lɛ, “Wo lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo muh wunɛ, wo bvûse Balaba yeh yi cha le wo nyâ bee le!”
Balaba wunɛ gɛ̀ bee yeh yi cha le nje wu gɛ̀ kɛ ŋgɛ alaantɛŋ wu yu muh.
Balɛt yu noo wu ka wu jɛmɛ bamii bachii le nje wu gɛ̀ goone ki wu chînɛ Jiso le.
Geenɛ, bo tu bo wanɛ gɛh lɛ, “Ba tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le, ba tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le!”
Balɛt ka wu jɛmɛ bamii le kiŋgane kintɛde lɛ, “Ba tâ wu nje la? Fiɛɛ fì befe fi wu ge le la? Mbaaŋ n'yɛŋ gɛ jialɛ chì wu ge le, ki ba yuuyɛ lo wu gɛ. Nlé ntaaŋ lo wu, nchinɛ wu le.”
Bo mo bo mɛ gɛh bo wanɛ lo bɛ bvuŋga lɛ, “Ba tâ lo wu yi kintaaŋ le.” Ŋ'waŋ wuboo ya Balɛt.
Noo, Balɛt suunɛ nsa wu chinɛ wu le, lɛ bo ge bɛ wu no bo koŋe.
Wu mo wu bvusɛ muh wɛɛ yeh yi ncha le, nyu wu wù bo gɛ̀ biide, wù gɛ̀ kɛ ŋgɛ alaantɛŋ wu ka wu yuuyɛ muh. No wu bvuse, wu mo wu nya Jiso no bo gɛ̀ goone.
Bo ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le

Bo mo bo jo Jiso bo gɛɛne bɛ wu. No bo gɛɛne, bo tasɛ bɛ muh mu wu kwɛɛde nchvuuŋ, jee che nyu lɛ Samoŋ, nyu muh wu Sɛliŋ. Bo tooŋsɛ wu bo mo bo gɛɛ kintaaŋ ki Jiso fɛ wu gbwe, wu mo wu tuu wu bii Jiso le.
Bɛ bo mo bo gɛɛne, kinchvu ki bamii ki duude bii bo le. Bamu nyu bikɛse bo gɛ̀ beede, bo taanyi baŋgɛ be.
Jiso ja wu kaasɛ ye wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bikɛse ba Yɛlusalɛm, keefɛ bɛŋ bêede fɛ mɛne gɛ. Bɛŋ bêede nyu fɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna le, mo fɛ booŋ bena le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ kife too lo kì ba lé ba gê ba jɛ̂me lɛ, njoŋ wù baaŋ le wù bikɛse ba le kaa bo baaŋ mwa boo gɛ, bo gɛ baaŋ mwa a yaŋse gɛ.
Lé gê nyû kife kiyu le, bamii wanɛ lɛ bambegɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ gwêeyɛ ye yese le’, bo wanɛ bambegɛ ba shige shige le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ bâŋɛ bee’.
Bo lé bo gê bo wânɛ noo nje bamii gee kfuu chi finɛ fiɛɛ bɛ kite kì baaŋ ki jiɛɛ, bo ge nɛɛ bɛ kì le ki yunɛ ka.”

content: No bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne bɛ Jiso noo, bo gɛ̀ kɛme bamii bancha bafɛɛ ba bɛ bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne ki bo yuuyɛ bo tɛ.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo bu kijusɛ kimu ki ba tɛŋe lɛ Ŋgboge wu Kikwɛɛ, bo mo bo ta Jiso yi kintaaŋ le, bo ta tɛ bamii bancha bafɛɛ baa yi bintaaŋ le, wu mumwaa a kibo ki Jiso kinchiɛɛŋ le, wumu a kibo kiŋkoŋo le.
Jiso ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Chii, lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ bi bamii banɛ, nje gɛ bo kee fiɛɛ fì bo gee gɛ.”

content: Bamii bayu jo njú yi Jiso bo tuŋ kaŋ yu ki bo ga bikwɛɛ biboo le.

Mwɛɛ munɛ munchii gɛ̀ kooshi bɛ Jiso noo, bamii lɛme fo bo jiiŋe. Bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ ka bo ja fiboo bo buu lo wu bo duu lɛ, “Wu chi fii bamii bamu, wu fi lɛ kikwɛɛ ke mɛɛse, wu nɛ le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, wu cha.”
Bamii ba nchi tɛ tu bo chwɛɛse wu, bo nya wu mbvuuŋ ma ŋgbwamɛ,
bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wo fɛnɛ le Nfoŋ wu Bajuu, fîh kikwɛɛ kuŋ.”
Bo saŋ ŋwa bo ta a kikwɛɛ ki Jiso we lɛ, “Wunɛ le Nfoŋ wu Bajuu.”
Muh wu ncha wumu wù bɛ bo gɛ̀ shɛnɛ yi bintaaŋ le fo, wu ja wu tu wu naanyi Jiso, wu duu lɛ, “Le gɛh wo wù Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka? Fîh kikwɛɛ kuŋ, wo fîh tɛ bee.”
Muh mu wɛɛ yu fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme, wu wamɛ wu bii lɛ, “Gɛ wo faane Nyo gɛ? Wo le yi ŋgɛ le yɛɛŋ nje no wu le.
Besa wo kwee nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nyu nlaŋe wu mwɛɛ mù mbefe mu besa wo ge le, geenɛ muh wunɛ kwe fie wu baaŋ jiaa gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ.”
Muh ncha wunɛ mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Jiso, wo ge wo tâne mɛ sege wo lé wo sâge bvunfoŋ bwuŋ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ lɛ abɛŋ le nyu besa wo kijusɛ ki njoŋ ki Nyo le.”

content: Jiso kwe
Juu gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ chi leesɛ, akfuuŋ ja ajiiŋ, woŋ wuchii gɛɛne bude juu bikaa bitɛde fɛnshɛ,
Nju yì gɛ̀ gade yeh yi kintanyɛ yi mo yi suunɛ antɛnɛɛ yi tu bimbe bifɛɛ.
Jiso gɛ̀ bee yi kintaaŋ le, wu ja wu waŋ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ,

content.text: “Chii, nnyaa kiyo kaŋ chiaaŋ yo le.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu yɛnɛ n'yɛnɛ wu kimaga.
Chiji kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi wù gɛ̀ lɛme fo, wu doo wu yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, wu nya mbɛɛŋsɛ Nyo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ, muh wunɛ chi bee gɛ bɛ jialɛ gɛ.”
Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ taashɛ fo ki bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, bo yɛŋ noo bo mo bo ja bo kaase bo kwɛɛde ala aboo le, bo soge bikwɛɛ.
Nsáa yi Jiso yichii gɛ̀ to fiboo yi lɛɛŋ nyu je yì ndefe le bo tu bo yɛde fiɛɛ fì kooshi le. Bamu gɛ̀ bee bikɛse ba gɛ̀ ja Galalee bo bi wu le.
Ba jiiyɛ Jiso

Muh mu gɛ̀ bee kife kiyu le ba tɛŋe lɛ Yosɛf, gɛ̀ bee muh wu a kinlaantɛŋ ki Bajuu kimi kì ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Alimatia. Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wù joŋe, ka nyume muh wù chaaŋ a Nyo jii, wu chiɛɛne tɛ kife kì Nyo lé wu gê wu tô wu sâge bvunfoŋ bwe. Wu gɛ̀ bee tɛ muh wu ŋgoo yi bamii ba gɛ̀ sage bansa le. Geenɛ, wu gɛ̀ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ fie fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ̀ seesɛ ki bo ge bɛ Jiso gɛ.
Wu gɛɛŋ fɛ Balɛt le, wu lɛgɛ ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu jo gvunɛ chi Jiso.
Balɛt bɛɛŋ, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu shiishɛ gvunɛ chiyu, wu baŋɛ a nju le wu tuu, wu gɛɛŋ wu giŋsɛ a jɛŋ yi ba gɛ̀ cho yi kimbaaŋ le, ba baaŋ muh yo a jiiyɛ gɛ.
Gɛ̀ bee Juu chi nseesɛ ki bo lee juu chi yuuŋ le, shɛge wa shige yuuŋ chiyu kɛ.
Bikɛse baa ba gɛ̀ ja Galalee bo bi Jiso le, bo bi Yosɛf le fɛ jɛŋ, ki bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ no wu giŋse gvunɛ chi Jiso a jɛŋ.
Bo gɛ̀ ja fo, bo mo bo tuu jiŋ ala aboo le, bo gɛɛŋ bo seesɛ mɛɛ mà joŋe mà yefɛ mà gwee wuŋ mà bo gɛ̀ yeefe agvuuŋ yu. Gɛ̀ bee juu chi yuuŋ, bo she yuuŋ no nchi wuboo gɛ̀ goone.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme gɛ kinchiŋ kinɛ gɛ.
